definitions.explanation: Individual pieces that make up a machine, device, or product.

examples.japanese: この{機械|きかい}の{部品|ぶひん}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: Some parts for this machine are missing.

examples.japanese: {自動車|じどうしゃ}{部品|ぶひん}を{製造|せいぞう}する{会社|かいしゃ}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a company that manufactures automobile parts.

examples.japanese: {部品|ぶひん}を{交換|こうかん}したら、{動|うご}くようになった。
examples.english: After replacing the parts, it started working.

notes:
{部品|ぶひん} refers to components that make up machines, electronics, vehicles, and other products.

Common collocations:
- {部品|ぶひん}を{交換|こうかん}する (to replace parts)
- {部品|ぶひん}を{取|と}り{寄|よ}せる (to order parts)
- {純正|じゅんせい}{部品|ぶひん} (genuine parts)
- {交換|こうかん}{部品|ぶひん} (replacement parts)

Industry terms:
- {自動車|じどうしゃ}{部品|ぶひん} (auto parts)
- {電子|でんし}{部品|ぶひん} (electronic components)
- {予備|よび}{部品|ぶひん} (spare parts)

Related terms:
- パーツ (parts - loanword)
